BAD_MESSAGE: Something went wrong inside the app
NOT_INITIALIZED: The analysis engine is still starting
NOT_INITIALIZED.fix: Wait a few seconds and try again.
INIT_FAILED: The analysis engine could not start
WASM_LOAD_FAILED: The analysis engine could not load
WASM_LOAD_FAILED.fix: Open the app once while online so all offline files download.
MODEL_LOAD_FAILED: The pose model could not load
MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.fix: Open the app once while online so all offline files download.
POSE_FAILED: Your body position could not be found
POSE_FAILED.fix: Keep your whole body in frame, in good light.
WEBCODECS_UNAVAILABLE: This device decodes in compatibility mode (slower)
UNSUPPORTED_CODEC: This device cannot decode this video format
UNSUPPORTED_CODEC.fix: Set the camera format to Most Compatible (H.264) and record again.
NO_VIDEO_TRACK: The file has no video in it
DEMUX_FAILED: This video file cannot be read
DEMUX_FAILED.fix: Choose an original MP4 or MOV from the phone camera.
DECODE_FAILED: The video could not be decoded
DECODE_FAILED.fix: In Photos use Save to Files, then import it from Files.
NO_DOCUMENT: Compatibility mode only runs in the main window
NO_SWING_FOUND: No complete swing was found in the video
NO_SWING_FOUND.fix: Make sure the video shows the whole swing from address to finish.
ASSEMBLE_FAILED: Something went wrong while putting the results together
OUT_OF_MEMORY.fix: Close other apps or trim the video, then try again.
INTERNAL.fix: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the report in Settings › Diagnostics.
GPU_UNAVAILABLE: The GPU is not available; using the CPU (slower)
MODULE_MISSING: This version does not include this feature
QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The phone is out of storage space
QUOTA_EXCEEDED.fix: Free up space in Settings › Storage.
ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT: Analysis took too long and was stopped
ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT.fix: Try again, or trim the video.
WORKER_CRASHED: The analysis engine stopped responding and was restarted
WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: The analysis engine is not available
FILE_TRUNCATED.fix: Wait until the video has fully downloaded or copied, then import it.
CAMERA_DENIED.fix: Go to Settings › Safari › Camera, choose Allow, then tap Try again.
CAMERA_BUSY: Another app is using the camera
CAMERA_BUSY.fix: Close the other app using the camera, then tap Try again.
BAD_QUERY: The search could not be run
BAD_RECORD: The data is not in the expected format
VERSION_NEWER: The data comes from a newer version of the app
BACKEND: Data on this phone cannot be accessed
UNSUPPORTED: This device does not support this feature
NO_WAKE_LOCK: The screen cannot be kept on
NO_WAKE_LOCK.fix: Set Auto-Lock to a longer time.
NO_MEDIA_DEVICES: This browser cannot use the camera
